器物建筑年岁与anchor；既有东街灯祠与瓦灯魅模板","calibration":"同器物的待审定占位；建筑没有builtAt/madeAt/foundedYear时不凭空追认年代。","boundary":"不补写灯祠成立年、不新设宗教权限；生灵有spirit:object来源、anchor与causes。"},"sourceFacts":{"anchor":{"id":"bld_bs_temple","name":"东街灯祠","parent":"loc_bs_dongxue","scope":"loc_bs","aliases":[],"coordinates":[24.325,0.3],"terrain":"平地","openHours":[420,1140],"purpose":"送行与灯会联络","owner":"loc_bs","rooms":[{"id":"room_bs_temple_front","name":"公开接洽前厅","purpose":"灯架、避风门廊","access":"营业时接洽；内室和财物另须许可"}],"inventory":{},"description":"东街灯祠用于送行与灯会联络，可见灯架、避风门廊。门廊可歇脚，供灯须先问保管人。前厅接洽时间为每日7时至19时，打烊后另约。","features":[{"id":"feature_s3_altar_lamp","name":"祠堂供灯","aliases":[],"kind":"lamp","owner":"npc_bs_080_3","access":"consent","position":[0,1],"state":{"emissionLuxAt1m":30,"heightMeters":1.5,"lit":true,"covered":false}},{"id":"feature_s3_offering_table","name":"灯祠供案","aliases":[],"kind":"surface","owner":"npc_bs_080_3","access":"consent","position":[1,0],"state":{"focusAreaM2":0.5}},{"id":"feature_s3_bronze_mirror","name":"祠中铜镜","aliases":[],"kind":"surface","owner":"npc_bs_080_3","access":"consent","position":[1,1],"state":{"reflectivityPercent":60,"reflectionAreaM2":0.3}},{"id":"feature_s3_side_seat","name":"祠中侧席","aliases":[],"kind":"surface","owner":"loc_bs","access":"public","position":[2,1],"state":{}},{"id":"feature_s3_rest_couch","name":"偏殿卧榻","aliases":[],"kind":"prop","owner":"npc_bs_080_3","access":"consent","position":[-1,0],"state":{"radiusMeters":1.5}},{"id":"feature_s3_side_passage","name":"灯祠侧廊","aliases":[],"kind":"passage","owner":"npc_bs_080_3","access":"consent","position":[0,-1],"state":{"widthMeters":1.5}},{"id":"feature_s3_fog_stand","name":"祠前雾灯台","aliases":[],"kind":"prop","owner":"npc_bs_078_2","access":"consent","position":[1,-1],"state":{"radiusMeters":2}},{"id":"feature_s3_porch_lamp","name":"祠前廊灯","aliases":[],"kind":"lamp","owner":"loc_bs","access":"public","position":[-1,1],"state":{"emissionLuxAt1m":20,"heightMeters":2.5,"lit":true,"covered":false}},{"id":"feature_s3_ore_tray","name":"祠前矿样盘","aliases":[],"kind":"sample","owner":"loc_bs","access":"public","position":[-1,-1],"state":{"sampleType":"mineral","sampleGrams":30,"heightMeters":0.1,"spectrum":[{"wavelengthNm":450,"reflectance":0.12},{"wavelengthNm":550,"reflectance":0.2},{"wavelengthNm":650,"reflectance":0.62}]}},{"id":"feature_s3_incense_post","name":"祠前香柱","aliases":[],"kind":"prop","owner":"loc_bs","access":"public","position":[-0.5,1.5],"state":{"heightMeters":1}},{"id":"feature_s3_screen_wall","name":"祠前影壁","aliases":[],"kind":"surface","owner":"loc_bs","access":"public","position":[0,2],"state":{}},{"id":"feature_s3_old_mortar","name":"祠前旧药臼","aliases":[],"kind":"surface","owner":"loc_bs","access":"public","position":[-2,0],"state":{"wear":[{"kind":"研磨凹痕","depthMm":1.5,"lengthMm":40},{"kind":"细裂纹","depthMm":0.3,"lengthMm":12}]}},{"id":"feature_s3_drying_cloth","name":"祠前晾帕","aliases":[],"kind":"object","owner":"loc_bs","access":"public","position":[-1,-2],"state":{},"thermalModel":{"ambientC":20,"heatCapacityJPerC":400,"maximumC":100,"passiveExchangeJPerMinute":200,"burnMgPerMinute":1,"fuelJPerMg":1,"efficiencyPermille":1,"ashPermille":0,"ignitionMaximumMg":1,"ignitable":false,"dryable":true,"fuels":[]},"thermalInitial":{"temperatureC":20,"fuelMg":0,"moistureMg":5000}},{"id":"feature_s3_dark_corner","name":"祠后暗角","aliases":[],"kind":"prop","owner":"loc_bs","access":"public","position":[5,-5],"state":{}},{"id":"feature_s4_lintel_altar","name":"门印神坛","aliases":[],"kind":"altar","owner":"npc_bs_080_3","access":"consent","position":[-2,1],"state":{"deity":"deity_lintel","church":"门印证契堂","integrity":100,"contamination":60,"pollutionKind":"ordinary"}}]},"species":{"id":"monster_tile_lamp_wraith","name":"瓦灯魅","aliases":[],"template":1,"levelRange":[1,5],"habitatTags":["西郊废窑"],"grouping":"一至三盏","diet":"不吃活物；啜饮窑场里残留的灯油和蜡渣","drops":[{"item":"item_clay_oil_lamp","amount":1}],"intelligence":1,"taming":{"possible":false,"conditions":["器物精怪没有驯服办法"]},"wildlife":{"habitat":"habitat_bs_west_kiln","population":3,"capacity":6,"recoveryPerWeek":0,"activeHours":[1140,240],"predatorOf":[],"distinction":"一盏没人点也亮着的旧陶灯，在碎瓦堆上自己挪动","gather":{"minutes":5,"tool":null,"consumes":[]},"manifest":{"perWeek":1,"seasons":[0,1,2,3],"cause":"窑场里被丢弃的旧陶灯沾上夜里的残火，自己游走起来"}},"nature":{"lineage":"中式","group":"妖怪","kind":"器物精怪","civilized":false,"reproduction":"manifest","spirit":{"nature":"malevolent","rank":0},"affinity":{"weak":["magic_wind"],"resist":["magic_fire"]}},"appearance":"一盏浅腹旧陶灯，灯沿缺了一角，没有人点却亮着一朵豆大的黄火，火苗总是斜向一边。陶灯底下看不见腿，却能在碎瓦堆上一顿一顿地自己挪动，挪过的地方留下一道细细的油痕。","habits":"19:00至次日04:00出没，白天火苗熄灭，混在碎瓦堆里与普通破灯无异。一至三盏在窑场里游走，专找窑洞角落的残油和蜡渣，靠近便把火苗压低，像在啜饮。它不会生养；窑场里被丢弃的旧陶灯沾上夜里的残火，就会自己游走起来，成为新的瓦灯魅。","threat":"喜欢凑近人身上的油脂和蜡烛，偶尔会燎着衣角、烧坏干粮袋。火焰类法术打在它身上只剩一半伤害。风类法术吹得火苗乱晃，伤它更重。驱邪、净场的法事可以把它驱离。夜里经过窑场，收好灯油和蜡烛就不太会招惹它。","materials":"在交手中把瓦灯魅打灭后，空手花五分钟能从余烬里拣出一盏浅腹陶油灯，擦净后照常添油点用。用法事驱离的瓦灯魅会直接消失，什么也留不下。","folklore":"镇上人说，瓦灯魅是窑工的魂附在灯上，夜里还在窑场巡夜。拣砖的人见过它，它只是围着有油的地方转，从不巡什么夜；附在灯上的也不是哪个窑工，只是一点残火。镇上老窑工听了这说法都笑。","voice":"没有叫声，火苗压低啜油时发出极轻的“滋滋”声；陶底擦过碎瓦时咯啦咯啦地响，在空窑里传得很远。","niche":"西郊废窑里的器物精怪，靠残油蜡渣维持火苗，不与活物争食，也不被野兽捕食。","relations":"镇上拣砖人夜里不进窑场；同在窑场的灰窟哥布林、余烬元素和酸苔软泥都与它各不相干。","tags":["ceramic","ember","spirit"]}}},"draft":{"id":"s507_building_lifecycle","row":{"awaken":{"minimumYears":100,"annualRisk":0.01,"species":"monster_tile_lamp_wraith"}}}}
